kypExtensions.summary: The response grammar distilled from the printed lead-in: every appropriate response in the 25-row table is patient-centered, open-ended, and empathetic — built from the three printed moves ACKNOWLEDGE OBSTACLES ('I understand this plan may be difficult...'), VALIDATE EMOTIONS ('It's understandable to feel frustrated...'), and CREATE OPEN-ENDED DIALOGUE ('What concerns you most about...?'), then checked against the four ethical principles (autonomy, beneficence, nonmaleficence, justice) through four lenses (patient, family, culture, healthcare team) — the decoder that separates the correct 'most appropriate response' from the directive, coercive, or dismissive distractors the exam plants.
kypExtensions.rationale: The lead-in sentences and the 25 situation/response pairs are printed; the grammar — reading each response as three moves plus a principle/lens check — and its use as a distractor-elimination tool are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVES 1–2 + mechanisms[0] response-grammar-map + blocks[4] the steps block + the registry visual's Zone A triad band

kypExtensions.summary: The 25 printed rows re-sorted into seven teaching clusters — ADHERENCE BARRIERS (rows 1, 3, 18: nonadherence, medication difficulty, alternative medicine — EXPLORE, DON'T COERCE), CONSENT & DISCLOSURE (2, 4, 5, 15: unnecessary procedure, family-asks-prognosis, family-asks-nondisclosure, uninsured treatment — THE PATIENT HOLDS THE INFORMATION), MINORS (6, 7, 23, 25: 17-year-old abortion, 15-year-old pregnancy, Jehovah's Witness transfusion, vaccine refusal — THE MINOR'S BODY, THE PARENT'S CONSENT), END-OF-LIFE & LOSS (8, 16, 20: physician-assisted dying, the bereaved 7-year-old, brain death — NEITHER HASTEN NOR PROLONG), BOUNDARIES & PROFESSIONALISM (10, 11, 12, 13: the date request, post-mastectomy 'ugly', waiting-room anger, complaint about another physician — ACKNOWLEDGE, DON'T ABSORB), SAFETY & REPORTING (9, 14, 17, 19, 24: suicidal patient, wrong-patient error, intimate partner violence, impaired colleague, suspected abuse — SAFETY TRUMPS PREFERENCE), and CONFLICTS OF INTEREST & CONSCIENCE (21, 22: pharmaceutical sponsorship, procedure against beliefs — DISCLOSE, DECLINE, REFER).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the rows in narrative order with no grouping; the seven-cluster taxonomy, the per-cluster principles, and the row-to-cluster assignment are KYP's synthesis (the printed row order is preserved in the two verbatim table blocks).
kypExtensions.location: core.what + core.keyIdea MOVE 3 + blocks[3] the cluster list + the registry visual's Zone B cards

kypExtensions.summary: The override map the exam actually tests: autonomy and family preference govern by default (the 15-year-old retains the right to decide about her child; a proxy may refuse emergent care for a KNOWN-PREFERENCE adult), but the table names the thresholds where preference yields — SAFETY (the actively suicidal patient 'may be hospitalized involuntarily if needed'), THE MINOR LINE ('Emergent care can be refused by the healthcare proxy for an adult... but not for a minor based solely on faith' — Transfuse daughter, but do not transfuse mother; routine vaccinations need the parent's consent), REPORTING DUTIES (impaired colleagues 'ethical and usually a legal obligation to report'; abuse 'required by law to report any reasonable suspicion'), and ERROR DISCLOSURE ('Regardless of the outcome, a physician is ethically obligated to inform a patient that a mistake has been made') — plus the near-miss boundaries (therapeutic privilege only when the patient 'might seriously harm self or others'; IPV disclosure to authorities NOT pressed 'unless required by state law').
kypExtensions.rationale: The threshold rows are printed individually; the synthesis that reads them as four named override categories against the autonomy default — and the near-miss contrasts (therapeutic privilege's narrow trigger, IPV's non-mandatory reporting) — are KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: mechanisms[1] autonomy-threshold-map + blocks[4] the steps block QUESTIONS 3–4 + the clinical block + the registry visual's rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the two-page table — 4 patterns (the nonadherence stem routed to obstacles-not-lecture, the family-nondisclosure request routed to explore-plus-therapeutic-privilege, the Jehovah's Witness emergency routed to transfuse-the-minor-only, the impaired-colleague/abuse stems routed to the reporting duties), 4 traps (explore vs refer — the table says 'Do not... refer' for nonadherence and the unnecessary procedure but 'offer to refer' when the procedure violates YOUR beliefs; the 17-year-old vs 15-year-old pregnancy rows; therapeutic privilege vs ordinary disclosure; IPV — do NOT pressure to leave or disclose vs abuse/impairment — MUST report), 3 pivots (empathetic-open-ended beats directive on 'most appropriate response' lists; the patient's wishes control information, not the family's; the reporting cluster vs confidentiality), and 8 recall cards covering the clusters row by row.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the situations and responses only; the attack structure, the distractor logic, and the question shapes are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The mnemonic ledger and the visual rebuild: NO mnemonic of First Aid's own prints anywhere on either page (VLM census, staging-pubh24/vlm-census.txt — no margin notes, no red in-cell mnemonic lines; the lead-in's first-letter red styling is a styling convention, not a mnemonic), so all four mnemonics are KYP ORIGINALS, marked as such: 'ACKNOWLEDGE, VALIDATE, ASK' (the lead-in triad), 'EXPLORE, DON'T COERCE' (the adherence/requests cluster), 'SAFETY, MINORS, REPORTS' (the three override thresholds), and 'FOUR PRINCIPLES, FOUR LENSES' (autonomy-beneficence-nonmaleficence-justice × patient-family-culture-team). The two-page table is rebuilt as ONE registry visual (challenging-scenarios-map, ChallengingScenariosMap in visuals/pubhealth-p24.tsx): the lead-in triad band with the three printed example phrases, seven themed cluster cards carrying all 25 situations with verbatim response-principle key phrases, and the override-threshold rule strip — NOT a 25-row wall.
kypExtensions.rationale: No FA-own mnemonic prints on pdf 296-297 (VLM-confirmed), so nothing is carried attributed and all four codes are KYP originals; the cluster-card layout, the triad band, and the rule strip are KYP original art preserving every printed situation and the verbatim key phrases of every response.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics + blocks[7] the memory callout + blocks[0] the visual block + the registry visual
